description: This Java class 'DeviceCertificateValidator' implements certificate chain validation for devices using Java's security APIs, including methods to validate certificate chains against trust anchors with detailed logging.

classes.name: DeviceCertificateValidator
classes.description: A class that validates device certificate chains using Java's CertPathValidator, implementing the X509CertificateChainValidator interface.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a certificate chain against a trust anchor, returning a Future that completes if validation succeeds or fails if it does not.
